pack.topic: Strategic Portfolio Anchoring for Real Estate Investors
pack.source_script_insight: The source emphasizes holding a core guiding framework constant while navigating shifting external environments, ensuring resilience against uncertainty.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Applying a disciplined portfolio strategy to Coimbatore property investments, balancing asset types across expanding corridors like Avinashi Road and Thudiyalur without emotional overextension.
pack.visual_strategy: Uses tight, photorealistic inspection of portfolio allocation matrices, physical registry files on a wooden desk, and street-level environmental checks in Coimbatore to demonstrate structured decision-making, avoiding generic family or plot montages.
pack.core_takeaway: A disciplined framework protects your real estate portfolio against market volatility.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK: Exact 10-second duration, native vertical 9:16 portrait orientation, full-screen composition designed for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

B. REALISM LOCK: 100% photorealistic physical-world footage shot with a mirrorless camera (Sony FX3 style). No cartoonish rendering, no 3D animation, no CGI graphics, no plastic textures. Natural lighting, authentic textures of paper, wood, and concrete in Coimbatore.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK: The core subject is portfolio strategy in real estate investment, emphasizing structured anchoring, disciplined timing, and clarity amidst market complexity. Applied specifically to Coimbatore investors.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY: Avoid generic plot-to-house tropes. Use close-up analytical shots, document inspection, and calm office environments to demonstrate deliberate portfolio planning.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY: Stable, professional cinematography, shallow depth of field, natural 50mm framing for desk shots, eye-level stability, realistic shadows and color grading.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN:
- Shot 1 (0.0 - 1.4s): Close-up of a fountain pen hovering over a structured real estate portfolio allocation chart on a wooden desk. Text: 'திட்டம் என்ன?'. VO: 'சொத்து வாங்கும் முன்...'
- Shot 2 (1.4 - 2.8s): Macro focus on certified property title deeds and boundary maps, fingers turning paper. Text: 'சரியான கணக்கு'. VO: 'சரியான திட்டம் இருக்கா?'
- Shot 3 (2.8 - 4.2s): Eye-level shot of a calculator and filter coffee cup on a desk. Text: 'அவசரம் வேண்டாம்'. VO: 'அவசரப்பட்டு இறங்காதீங்க.'
- Shot 4 (4.2 - 5.6s): Street-level view of Coimbatore traffic and buildings under clear daylight. Text: 'சந்தை நிலவரம்'. VO: 'காலத்தை கணித்து செயல்படுங்கள்.'
- Shot 5 (5.6 - 7.0s): A hand placing a paperweight on an investment roadmap. Text: 'தெளிவான பார்வை'. VO: 'முதலீட்டில் தெளிவு வேண்டும்.'
- Shot 6 (7.0 - 8.5s): Medium shot of an investor reviewing blueprints near a window. Text: 'உறுதியான முடிவு'. VO: 'சந்தை மாறலாம், உங்கள் திட்டம் உறுதியாக இருக்கட்டும்.'
- Shot 7 (8.5 - 10.0s): Polished wooden desk with organized property folders and subtle OliveTree Investors watermark. Text: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ இன்வெஸ்டர்ஸ்'. VO: 'சரியான முடிவுகள், நிலையான லாபம் தரும். ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ இன்வெஸ்டர்ஸ்.'

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT: Only minimal clean text overlays on real footage.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE: Finish on the professional desk setup with OliveTree Investors branding.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES: No 2D/3D cartoon animations, no explainer graphics, no artificial CGI, no landscape orientation, no black bars, no fake landmarks, no duplicated people.

Avoid impulsive decisions and anchor your investments with structured planning.
